entries.borrowed_method: Fix shared-queue and service conditions while separating class source and routing decisions.
entries.boundary: DiffFlow uses sampled long-flow classification, Java without full TCP, and class-independent queues. Its normalized mean FCT cannot establish this node's RDMA batch/P99 gain.
entries.project_difference_and_applicable_condit: The node holds real shared FIFO queues and swaps class composition at equal wire-byte backlog; it does not introduce per-class queues or packet spraying.

entries.borrowed_method: Use the maximum completion time with the full request/batch origin; inspect per-QP paths and actual transport costs.
entries.boundary: The fixed preprint's final journal text was not compared. Host shaper and aggregate-CQE semantics and author FCT figures cannot be transferred as project evidence.
entries.project_difference_and_applicable_condit: The node aggregates three existing tag2 QPs from 2.000000 s and separately measures the probe released at 2.000020 s. It does not split WQEs, create child QPs or use path-blacklist feedback.

entries.borrowed_method: Check transport-dependent opportunities to adapt and distinguish changed allocation from business completion time.
entries.boundary: Random flowlet reselection, elastic flowlet size, TCP/OMNeT++ and hardware results do not establish a gain for the fixed RDMA QP fixture or MoE batches.
entries.project_difference_and_applicable_condit: The node pins every probe packet to its first chosen port; equal backlog and common release hold give no flowlet adaptation opportunity. Later arrivals reveal cost transfer between destination groups.
